# Mass General Brigham

> > Integrated healthcare system uniting Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women's Hospital, and affiliated institutions to deliver comprehensive patient care, research, and medical education.

Mass General Brigham is an academic healthcare system affiliated with Harvard Medical School, operating hospitals including Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women's Hospital, and community facilities across Massachusetts and New Hampshire. The system provides primary care, specialty services, urgent care, rehabilitation through Spaulding Rehabilitation Network, and virtual care accessed via the Patient Gateway portal.

## Key Topics

- Massachusetts General Hospital
- Brigham and Women's Hospital
- Patient Gateway
- Harvard Medical School

## Getting Started

- [Mass General Brigham | Integrated Health Care System](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en): Homepage for Mass General Brigham integrated healthcare system
- [Patient Care | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care): Patient-centered care overview with Patient Gateway portal access
- [Services and Specialties | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties): Complete directory of services from primary to specialty care

## Locations and Access

- [Locations | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/locations): Directory of hospitals, community centers, and specialty facilities
- [Find a Location | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/find-a-location): Locate Mass General, Brigham and Women's, and other facilities

## Primary and Urgent Care

- [Primary Care | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/primary-care): Primary care providers offering preventive and chronic disease care
- [Urgent Care | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/urgent-care): Walk-in urgent care for minor illnesses and injuries
- [Home Care | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/home-care): Medicare-covered home health services and recovery care

## Specialty Services

- [Sports Medicine: Individual Care Plans | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/sports-medicine): Sports medicine for athletes including New England Patriots physicians
- [Rehabilitation | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/rehabilitation): Spaulding Rehabilitation Network offers comprehensive rehab programs
- [The Asthma Center | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/asthma-center): Comprehensive asthma care by allergists and pulmonologists
- [Specialty Pharmacy | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/specialty-pharmacy): Specialty medication management for chronic conditions
- [Pediatric Multiple Sclerosis | Mass General Brigham](https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/patient-care/services-and-specialties/pediatric-ms): Pediatric MS treatment at Massachusetts General Hospital
